title: Mobile, AL — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]

content:
Overview

Mobile is a city in AL with a population of 187,041. Port City with Mardi Gras origin, Gulf Coast beaches, and very affordable living. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 8b growing zone supports Warm — citrus, avocados, tomatoes, peppers. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
